prototypeScope: V1.37 (reissue): two cup jaw rings (one spare) on one Black plate.
knownFitBoundary: Bore 10.5 on the dia 10.0 boss and OD 14.0 in the seat, as the old ring; the pilot 1.6 for M2 TAP. The 2.5 drill is done by hand; the boss is not cut; printed sizes not measured.
processOverrideReason: Black: each 0.1 mm layer of the two 14 mm rings took about 4 s at the donor speeds (their 4 s minimum), so the top of the first plate melted into a lump (Shawn 2026-10-29). Minimum layer time 12 s (slow down to 5 mm/s) on the X1C; Orca loads the Elegoo filament profile over the project, so there the wall and infill speeds drop to 35 mm/s instead (fan already at full below 80 s layers). Each layer then has time to set. The Elegoo plate with brim (IMG_7205) kept the brim and the first layer on the bed and lost both rings above layer 1: the nozzle knocked the 0.1 mm layers loose, so the Elegoo prints 0.2 mm layers and lifts on every travel.

parts.sourceFrame: print frame: closed end on the bed, sleeve up (robot frame: x - 26.1, z - 118.62, -y - 33.5)
parts.poseOrigin: Closed end on the bed, open sleeve up: the 3.3 mm solid bottom is a flat disc on the bed and the sleeve wall is vertical, so nothing needs support; the M2 pilot is vertical.

poseCheck.note: STL written in its print pose (identity)

parts.changeReason: D-033 (Shawn 2026-10-29: "右下颚连接处的圈掉了 … 设计一个圆圈 通过螺丝固定在右下颚上", "能不能直接一个件搞定", "有螺丝固定就不用那个特别薄的挡板了吧"; reissue: "为什么这么薄 以前也是这样的吗", "不可能的 我看空间很大", "你出吧"): one-piece cup ring, OD 14.0, bore 10.5, 6.1 mm tall: a 2.8 mm sleeve over the whole uncut boss, then a 3.3 mm solid bottom with a dia 1.6 pilot, no flange. It fills the 10 mm seat between the lower shell and the jaw support (bore r 7.3 and 8.4 along it) to y -33.5, so it is fitted after the jaw is sprung in (dropped into the open half-seat and slid 2.8 mm onto the boss; path checked clear). One M2 x 10 from outside the arm (hole drilled to 2.5) gives 2.69 mm of thread in the bottom. Clear of the lower shell 0.3 mm and the jaw support 0.49 mm, as the old sleeve. The first 2.1 mm cup (1.5 mm plate under a 0.6 mm lip) failed to print three times. Two copies: one spare.
parts.objectSettingsReason: the first V1.37 plate failed (Shawn 2026-10-29, IMG_7204): both 14 mm rings came off the textured plate after the first layers without a brim (R1 default: tip angle over 10 deg, no brim); a small part with 146 mm2 of contact keeps the 5 mm outer brim to stay down

retiredParts.reason: replaced by the V1.37 cup jaw ring held by one M2 x 10 (D-033); the old ring fell off the right jaw boss
